fusions.name: Flaxen Lash
fusions.desc: Whips a length of woven flax across a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage with a 50% chance to leave each enemy [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Winding Sheet
fusions.desc: Wraps one enemy in wet linen for 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves it [Muddled] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Linen Dressing
fusions.desc: Binds the wounds of the ally who needs it most in linen, restoring 4 health a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Burr-Sewn Gambeson
fusions.desc: Conjures a gambeson that lowers every hit you take by 2 and raises your armour by 8%. 10% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
